name: voice-reply
description: Claude ends each reply with a short spoken line; play it with a button, or let the session speak it by itself. Gemini TTS, with the system voice as fallback. Windows, macOS, Linux.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: From aistudio.google.com/apikey. Empty: the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable, then ~/.claude/voice/gemini.key, then the system voice.

gemini_voice.title: Gemini voice
gemini_voice.description: A Gemini TTS voice name, e.g. Achird, Kore, Puck, Charon, Aoede.

style.title: Speaking style
style.description: How the Gemini voice should sound, in plain words.
style.default: calm, warm and friendly, conversational, like a colleague giving a quick spoken update; natural pace

ui_language.title: Button language
ui_language.description: Language of the buttons and messages: en or ru.
